### Olympic Trials
Author: Katherine Britton
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-aug-20-2008-11580691.html
Passage: Zechariah 13:9
Points:
- People often admire athletes who endure grueling tests, yet hesitate to embrace trials in their own lives.
- Hardship acts as a refining fire intended to melt away weaknesses and prove faith genuine.
- God's purpose in testing is not merely winning an award, but being transformed into pure gold.
- Believers cannot grow vicariously; they must actively pursue Christ and reflect His glory.
- Christians should train daily through prayer to be spiritually prepared for intense difficulties.

### Refined and Tested
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-dec-30-2009-11624216.html
Passage: Zechariah 13:9
Points:
- God's love includes refining His chosen people through difficult and painful trials.
- Believers often mistake hardship for God's absence rather than recognizing His purposeful refining hand.
- God allows the heat of testing to train His children to think and live according to His ways.
- The refining season is temporary and aims to teach believers to call on God and rely on Him.
- Enduring God's discipline leads to a harvest of righteousness and deep peace in knowing He is Lord.
